title: CINV-01: Brand management and optional product association
owner: Developer role; claimed at user instruction 2026-11-04
description: Implementation draft PR #66 at 8ae75bb; docs/tickets/CINV-01.md in implementation branch. 12 brand tests pass; 3 broader storefront failures reproduce on baseline. Independent review/browser QA pending; no merge.
acceptanceCriteria: Normalize names using the existing trim/case convention; a database constraint rejects duplicate/racing names.
Existing unbranded products remain valid. Inactive brands are unavailable for new assignments, but existing associations/products remain sellable and editable without forced unlinking.
Reuse image format/8 MB/storage validation and commit-safe cleanup; no new dependency or external asset.
Enforce view/add/change permissions and CSRF server-side; brands remain independent of category hierarchy.

Provide a dedicated Brands page/template and a permission-gated Brands link in the existing Catalog navigation. Preserve product, Orders, Dashboard and View Catalog routes; final sidebar grouping belongs to CINV-10.

title: CINV-02: Durable SKU issuance and pre-order correction history
description: Planning only. Scope, migration/recovery gates and QA scenarios: docs/catalog-inventory-plan.md and linked GitHub issue. Do not start development in this assignment.
acceptanceCriteria: Generate SKU-000001 style codes independently of database PKs; database uniqueness plus non-cycling sequence protects concurrent allocation and rollback gaps.
Reserve recoverable Product, ProductVariant, order-snapshot and audit-history codes; identify legitimate same-product aliases versus cross-product conflicts before constraints.
Never recycle an issued/retired/deleted code; seed above existing numeric codes and document incomplete deleted legacy history.

Explicit override permission; pre-first-order corrections retain old/new codes and actor/time history, including corrections after opening stock. Reject changes after an accepted order, including legacy product-only order lines.
No existing code is renumbered. Do not expose two writable SKU namespaces during rollout. Retain registry rows on product/variant deletion.

title: CINV-03: Extend existing variants and safely create default variants
description: Planning only. Scope, migration/recovery gates and QA scenarios: docs/catalog-inventory-plan.md and linked GitHub issue. Do not start development in this assignment.
acceptanceCriteria: Every simple product receives one default without manual variant entry; at most one default per product is enforced in PostgreSQL and creation is atomic.

Preserve Product and existing Variant IDs, SKUs, attributes, active states, photos and OrderItem relationships. Reuse an unambiguous existing matching variant; stop for reviewed mapping when ambiguous.
Keep package content (500 ml/1 kg) separate from stock units (bottle/pack/each/kg); preserve ambiguous legacy litre/ml meanings rather than guessing conversions.
Preflight cross-product SKU collisions, missing codes and multiple variants sharing positive product stock. Generate only missing identifiers through CINV-02.
Existing live-product cart IDs resolve to defaults; explicit live-product:variant IDs stay valid. Do not clear stored carts or rewrite historical line snapshots.
Additive, repeat-safe migration with reconciliation/recovery instructions; no stock copying to every variant and no second variant table.

title: CINV-04: Variant-owned cost, regular and sale pricing with compatibility
description: Planning only. Scope, migration/recovery gates and QA scenarios: docs/catalog-inventory-plan.md and linked GitHub issue. Do not start development in this assignment.
acceptanceCriteria: Cost/regular/sale prices are nonnegative; active sale price is strictly below regular price. Historical unknown cost is NULL, never fabricated zero.

Backfill each variant from its current effective regular/percentage-discount price using the existing PKR ROUND_HALF_UP behavior. Report zero-price/sale and other constraint exceptions without silent edits.
Update homepage/shop filtering/sorting, product view, cart quote/place, receipts/labels and current admin save paths together; cost never appears publicly.
Preserve original order line/price/tax/discount snapshots. Keep legacy columns during expansion, but remove duplicate writable price authorities at cutover.
Price schedule/timer implementation stays outside scope; existing promotional displays remain functional using authoritative prices.

title: CINV-05: Inventory balance and immutable movement foundation
description: Planning only. Scope, migration/recovery gates and QA scenarios: docs/catalog-inventory-plan.md and linked GitHub issue. Do not start development in this assignment.
acceptanceCriteria: Balance has decimal on_hand/reserved and configurable threshold; available is derived, not a separately writable total; DB rejects negative values and reserved > on_hand.
Preserve immutable opening/adjustment/order movement records with reason, signed quantity, timestamp, administrator, before/after values and SKU/item/unit snapshots.
Locks and unique operation keys prevent duplicate opening, adjustments or order deductions; deterministic lock order avoids deadlocks.

Retain archived balances and movement snapshots when Product/Variant is deleted. Use view-only default permissions plus explicit stock-adjust permission; do not expose generic movement/balance add/edit/delete operations in Roles/admin. Keep historical issued SKUs; both deactivation and deletion remain supported without automatic write-off/restock.
All stock is tracked. Reserved remains zero until separately approved lifecycle rules; do not implement reservations, expiry, refunds or universal conversion.
New tables/operations remain staged until the migration/cutover in CINV-06; no second live stock source.

title: CINV-06: Opening-stock migration and single-writer checkout stock cutover
description: Planning only. Scope, migration/recovery gates and QA scenarios: docs/catalog-inventory-plan.md and linked GitHub issue. Do not start development in this assignment.
acceptanceCriteria: Rehearse backup/restore, mapping and stock reconciliation; pause checkout/catalog stock writes during opening backfill and cutover. Do not infer pre-migration sales as new movements.

Copy current simple-product stock ONCE to its default balance and record one migration-opening movement. Require verified allocation for legacy multiple-variant shared positive stock; never duplicate it.

Switch checkout, +Stock, product creation and normal product editing together. Opening stock is allowed only at creation; remove arbitrary quantity overwrite on normal edits. Any compatibility mirror is read-only, not another authority.
Keep immediate deduction on successful placement. Movement, balance update, order snapshots and idempotency commit/rollback together; fulfillment/payment changes never deduct again.
Old integer cart identities remain accepted and aggregate correctly. No reservation expiry/cancel/refund/restock rule is introduced; reserved stays zero.
Preserve IDs, images, existing orders and amounts. Explicit recovery after live ledger writes must reconcile forward or account for post-backup orders, never blindly reverse migration/sequence state.

title: CINV-07: Stock overview, recorded adjustments and stock history
description: Planning only. Scope, migration/recovery gates and QA scenarios: docs/catalog-inventory-plan.md and linked GitHub issue. Do not start development in this assignment.
acceptanceCriteria: Show live and archived variant identity/unit, on_hand/reserved/available and threshold-driven stock status; pagination/search/filter are bounded and preserve query state.
Increases and decreases require nonzero valid amounts, a reason and a unique operation key; show actionable validation and actor/time history.
Concurrent writes use the shared locked operation; reject stock below zero/available reservations and duplicate submissions.

Retain view/adjust permission separation and server checks; history cannot be edited/deleted, including by direct admin URLs or generic model permissions. AuditEvent read-only patterns should be reused. Map old +Stock behavior to the same ledger rather than keeping a parallel writer.
Each route loads only its relevant HTML/assets, with common table/filter components reused. Opening stock is not silently reissued by editing a product.

title: CINV-08: 0.1 kg quantities across cart, checkout and order outputs
description: Planning only. Scope, migration/recovery gates and QA scenarios: docs/catalog-inventory-plan.md and linked GitHub issue. Do not start development in this assignment.
acceptanceCriteria: Accept exact decimal 0.1 kg steps and whole counts only for count units; reject unsupported steps, bool/NaN/infinity/exponent abuse, excessive precision and overflow server-side.
Migrate OrderItem quantity to decimal without changing historical quantities, line totals or printed prices. Define bounded decimal serialization compatible with old integer cart entries.
Update snapshot cart, shop/product quantity controls, quote/place validation, stock bounds and counts consistently; avoid binary-float price drift and retain PKR line rounding.
Product IDs, explicit variant IDs, browser/account cart ownership, repeat submissions and stock deduction semantics remain compatible.
Receipt/PDF/label/admin quantity formatting is correct; no universal ml/litre/kg conversion or reservation redesign.

title: CINV-09: Modular Add/Edit Product form using existing gallery
description: Planning only. Scope, migration/recovery gates and QA scenarios: docs/catalog-inventory-plan.md and linked GitHub issue. Do not start development in this assignment.
acceptanceCriteria: Basic fields: name, optional parent selector, validated filtered category, optional brand and description. Parent changes filter available categories; server rejects mismatched/parent categories.
Simple entry uses the automatic default; optional additional variants reveal their controls only when requested. Include generated/authorized SKU, barcode, package/unit and cost/regular/sale fields.
Opening stock is create-only and creates a movement; edits use stock adjustments. Threshold is configurable; tracking is checked/disabled because all items track stock.
Reuse existing multiple-image picker, preview/showcase selection, ordering, variant-photo association, deletion and upload validation; preserve stored paths/IDs.
Active and featured flags exist. Do not silently redefine homepage collections; coordinate #42 for merchandising.
Each selected submodule uses only its required template/assets. Native formset empty_form/template can create optional variant rows on demand; no pre-rendered collection of hidden module screens.
Inline errors, role-specific read-only fields, keyboard access and responsive layout remain usable.

title: CINV-10: Catalog and Inventory navigation with module-scoped rendering
description: Planning only. Scope, migration/recovery gates and QA scenarios: docs/catalog-inventory-plan.md and linked GitHub issue. Do not start development in this assignment.
acceptanceCriteria: Keep Dashboard, View Catalog, existing Orders below Inventory, Team, Security and Settings links and active states.
Preserve existing product/category/admin URLs and module permission checks; do not infer access from navigation visibility alone.
A selected module renders only its own template and CSS/JS, extending the shared shell and reusable partials. No one-page hidden-tab admin application.
Retain themed scrolling, mobile navigation, focus and direct-link behavior; labels distinguish catalog editing from stock operations.
Test route/asset isolation and worker role navigation for every new module.

title: CINV-11: Independent inventory/catalog migration and integration regression
dependencies: CINV-01, CINV-02, CINV-03, CINV-04, CINV-05, CINV-06, CINV-07, CINV-08, CINV-09, CINV-10
description: Planning only. Scope, migration/recovery gates and QA scenarios: docs/catalog-inventory-plan.md and linked GitHub issue. Do not start development in this assignment.
acceptanceCriteria: Separate disposable PostgreSQL database and synthetic media/records; migration fixtures cover simple, preexisting variant, duplicated-alias, shared-stock and deleted-history cases.
Reconcile IDs/SKUs/prices/stock totals/media/order snapshots before and after migration and after a recovery rehearsal; no destructive reset of retailer data.
Exercise SKU/stock/order concurrency, retries, rollback, permissions/CSRF and decimal quantities end to end, with no double deduction/reservation.
Check module-only rendering, category filters, gallery actions and responsive/keyboard behavior at approximately 1440/768/390 px; record browser/console/screenshot evidence when QA is authorized.
Link defects to their originating issue/PR, record retest and PM review, and disclose any blocked check. No old test result counts as validation of a new SHA.
Only recommend Awaiting My Review with evidence; user approval is still required to merge. No production rollout or new inventory lifecycle in this ticket.
